about: Centrum Capital is a diversified financial-services group operating across banking through Unity Small Finance Bank, investment banking, institutional and retail broking, wealth management, private-credit fund management, and insurance distribution. The group has transitioned from an advisory-led model into banking and other scalable financial platforms, while exiting affordable housing finance in March 2026. [1] [2]
